title: Account Keepalive Runway and Escalation
content:
Purpose:
This working doc is a tactical, time-boxed "runway" for at-risk renewals — built to give CSMs a structured escalation ladder and a short menu of mitigation plays that can be executed in the 90/60/30/14/7 day bands before renewal.

Audience:
CSMs, AEs, Solutions Eng, Renewal Ops, Customer Exec sponsors. Use this during QBR prep, post-QBR follow-ups, and urgent survival sprints.

Quick summary (one-liner):
Map the account's "days-to-renewal" to targeted failure-mode mitigations, concrete owner actions, and an escalation step if the signal worsens. 

Runway bands and objectives:
- 90+ days out: Diagnosis & alignment. Confirm stakeholding, usage/cost trends, roadmap fit.
- 60 days out: Mitigate early friction. Deploy low-lift product/ops fixes, executive touch, commercial accommodation if needed.
- 30 days out: Harden commitment. Formalize contract workaround, pilot extension, or structured SLA/discount offer.
- 14 days out: Exec readout + P0 interventions. Activate leadership escalation and finalize decision with written commitments.
- 7 days out: Final preservation. Legal/finance handoffs, signoff checklist, and backup continuation plan.

Signal matrix (quick scoring):
(Score 0-3 each: Usage change, Support volume, Executive engagement, Contract health, Product regressions)
- 0: normal, 1: early warning, 2: concerning, 3: critical
- Triage threshold: total >=6 -> open "Renewal Runway" channel and submit one-pager to Execs

Failure modes & immediate plays (short menu):
1) Usage collapse (sudden token/embedding/feature drop)
  - Root causes: product adoption, API errors, cost shocks
  - Immediate plays: 48h usage pulse (SE-led), temporary quota increase + protective guardrails, highlight quick wins in QBR slides
  - Owner: CSM + Solutions Eng (48h)

2) Cost surprise / unexpected billing spike
  - Root causes: bursty traffic, misconfigured batching, usage of high-cost endpoints
  - Immediate plays: offer one-off credit or invoice smoothing, apply token-level throttles, propose Optimize review (quantization/batching recommendations)
  - Owner: AE (commercial), Eng (technical cap)

3) Leadership change / procurement freeze
  - Root causes: buyer left, re-org, budget hold
  - Immediate plays: escalate to sponsor's peer + brief exec note, present short-term proof of value tied to top-line KPIs, offer an in-contract pilot extension with milestone payments
  - Owner: AE + CSM (commercial + exec alignment)

4) Technical regression / reliability incidents
  - Root causes: recent deploy, latency/accuracy regressions
  - Immediate plays: open SRE/incident bridge, provide hotfix ETA, isolate traffic to stable model variant, standby SE for customer demo
  - Owner: SRE/Support + Solutions Eng

5) Security/compliance concern (audit fail, new policy)
  - Root causes: data handling, access controls
  - Immediate plays: offer workshop with security & compliance, propose on-prem/private deployment evaluation, provide SOC/pen-test artifacts
  - Owner: Security + Solutions Eng + CSM

Escalation ladder (who to loop and when):
- Stage 1: CSM triage (score 1-5) — notify AE, set 48h mitigation tasks
- Stage 2: AE + Solutions Eng (score 6-8 OR repeated incidents) — commercial contingency and technical workaround planned (72h)
- Stage 3: Senior CS Manager + Sales Leader (score 9-11 OR 30-day failing trajectory) — financial offers, exec alignment call scheduled (7d notice)
- Stage 4: VP Customer Success / CRO (score >=12 OR 14-day P0) — prepare exec readout packet and remediation contract

Run-of-show for Exec Escalation Call (30–45 minutes):
- Pre-reads: 1-pg summary, recent usage graph (last 90 days), top 3 failure-root hypotheses, proposed 72h actions + owners
- Call agenda: 5m context; 10m metrics & incidents; 10m customer perspective & risk; 10m proposed rescue plays; 5m decisions & next steps
- Deliverables within 24h: confirmed owners, updated mitigation timeline, one-sentence public exec memo for customer

Play library (short, actionable cards):
- Short-term: "Quota Cushion" — grant a temporary quota and apply rate limit guardrails, measure effect for 14 days
- Mid-term: "Pilot Re-anchor" — extend pilot for 60 days tied to 3 KPIs; include milestone-based payment
- Commercial: "Commitment Swap" — offer a shorter, higher-rate contract with opt-out for first 30 days of renewal period (reduces upfront risk for customer)
- Technical: "Model Variant Fallback" — route traffic to earlier verified model variant for 48–96h while fix deploys
- Executive: "Sponsored Roadmap Slot" — commit a roadmap demo to customer within next quarter with named PM on the thread

Tracking table template (paste into sheet/CS tool):
Columns: account | renewal_date | days_to_renewal | runway_score | primary_failure_mode | active_play | play_owner | next_action_due | escalation_stage | notes | last_update
Example row: Acme Inc | 2026-04-06 | 34 | 8 | usage-collapse | Quota Cushion | Maya T | 2026-03-10 | Stage 2 | awaiting SE pulse | 2026-03-05

Communication artifacts (templates):
- Quick Exec Intro (email subject): "Urgent: [Customer] renewal risk — proposed 72h runway plan"
- Body skeleton: short context (1–2 lines), key metric(s) changed, proposed immediate actions (bulleted), ask (decision/approval), and suggested time for exec readout
- Customer-facing QBR addendum: 1-page value summary, near-term remediation plan, measurable KPIs and dates, named owners

Example: Customer email to re-anchor contract
Subject: Proposal to de-risk [Customer] renewal 
Hi [Sponsor],
We saw a meaningful drop in daily usage since the 2/20 deploy (–42%). To avoid disruption at renewal and get you the outcomes promised, we propose a 60-day pilot extension tied to three KPIs: (1) weekly active endpoints, (2) inference latency < 300ms 95th, (3) accuracy on the validation set > 86%. We will commit a named SE and weekly checkpoints. Can we align on this by Friday?

Notes to self / working items (CSM checklist):
- Attach recent 90-day usage graphs and error-rate chart to every escalation packet
- Confirm PO/Procurement timelines with AE and legal (two business days)
- Run quick Optimize review (batching/quant recommendations) and attach findings
- Book exec readout slot before legal draft when score crosses threshold

Retention heuristics (things we learned):
- Early credit offers without technical fixes rarely convert (need paired technical mitigation)
- Exec involvement matters most when there is a clear customer KPI tied to revenue impact
- Short, milestone-tied extensions reduce churn more than flat discounts

Open questions / TODOs:
- Build a lightweight dashboard view (CS tool) for runway_score and last 7-day signal delta (Owner: Analytics, ticket CSUP-4127)
- Create a canned 1-page slide template for exec readout (Owner: Growth Ops)
- Align legal on 30/60-day pilot amendment template (Owner: Legal)

References and links:
- Confluence renewal templates: CONFLUENCE:CS-Renewal-Templates-2026
- Incident impact matrix (SRE): /sre/incidents/renewal-impact
- Example saved deal: [internal link] (see Jira CSUP-3921)

Status note: Draft for CS leadership review. Intend to test as part of March renewal-week triage and iterate based on outcomes.

---
